source: ATO Cycle III Storybook — Hypertime Oracle Battle (p.128-129)
_notes: Timefront tiles (1x4 + 2x 1x5) fill column 1. Coloured squares (red, green, yellow, blue → Titan 1-4) = Time Anchor spaces. Flame tokens (J9, I9, F9, E9) = Titan start spaces, chosen freely by the players.

Terrain cards CI1310-CI1314: Timefront = Board Edge, Boundless, Indestructible (death by moving onto/beyond it → erased). Time-frozen City = Obscuring, Inhabited, Destructible, Cover (not an Obstacle; Thaw Time is campaign-only). Black Iceberg 1x1 / Giant 2x2 = Obstacle, Obscuring, Destructible, Trap, Black Ice. Flame tokens on column 9 not modelled (unknown).
setup: Primordial Positioning: indicated space in the centre (G13-H14); it faces the Titans.
Additional Setup: set the Aeons Tsunami AI III card aside. Time Anchors on Titan start spaces.
